tools.name: get_current_time
tools.description: Returns the current date and time in ISO format.
tools.script: const tz = args.timezone || 'UTC'; const now = new Date(); return { time: now.toLocaleString('en-US', { timeZone: tz }), timezone: tz, iso: now.toISOString() };
